newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann names new head at Arcor unit.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann names new head at Arcor unit.

text.p: Germany's Mannesmann AG said on Friday the head of its mobile phone network would move over to take control of its Arcor telecommunications venture.

Harald Stoeber, general manager of Mannesmann Mobilfunk GmbH, which operates Germany's leading mobile network, would become chief exeuctive of Mannesmann Arcor in July, replacing Peter Mihatsch. Mihatsch would continue to head up Mannesmann's telecommunications operations as a member of its management board.

Arcor, a venture with the telephone network of railway Deutsche Bahn AG, aims to become Germany's number two phone company behind Deutsche Telekom AG. The unit has a partnership with AT&T Corp. and Unisource NV, a consortium of national phone companies in Europe.
